name: Unusual Vehicle Noises & Acoustic Diagnostics
disclaimer: Unusual sounds are the early warning signs of mechanical wear or loose structural components.

symptoms: Fast rhythmic ticking noise in top of engine
Deep heavy metallic knocking or tapping from bottom of engine under load
potentialCauses: Low engine oil level / low oil pressure
Hydraulic lifter tick / valve train wear
Rod bearing knock (Severe bottom end damage)
subtopics.criticalWarning: A heavy deep engine knock means imminent catastrophic engine failure. Turn off engine immediately and check oil dipstick.
triageQuestions: Is it a light top-end tick or a heavy low-pitch metallic thud?
Have you checked your engine oil level on the dipstick?
subtopics.recommendedAction: Immediate engine oil level verification, oil pressure check, acoustic stethoscope inspection.

symptoms: Loud humming / droning airplane sound at 30-60 mph
Noise pitch gets louder when turning wheel left or right
subtopics.criticalWarning: Severely degraded wheel bearings can overheat, seize, or cause the wheel to separate from the vehicle.
triageQuestions: Does the noise change or get louder when you steer left versus steering right?
Does the humming seem to come from a specific corner of the car?
subtopics.recommendedAction: Wheel bearing play and runout inspection on a 2-post lift.

symptoms: Clunking / rattling over speed bumps or potholes
Popping / clicking noise when turning sharp corners while accelerating
potentialCauses: Worn sway bar end links / bushings
Worn outer CV (Constant Velocity) axle joint
triageQuestions: Does the popping sound happen specifically when making a full tight turn (U-turn)?
Does the clunk occur when going over rough roads or speed bumps?
subtopics.recommendedAction: Suspension multi-point inspection, ball joint and CV boot/axle evaluation.

symptoms: Loud bird-like squeal when starting engine or turning steering wheel all the way
potentialCauses: Glazed or loose serpentine accessory belt
triageQuestions: Does the squeal happen when turning on the AC or steering to full lock?
subtopics.recommendedAction: Drive belt tension inspection and belt replacement.

triageRules: Differentiate light vibrations from deep structural knocks.
Prioritize bottom-end knocks and loose steering/wheel bearing noises for urgent shop inspection.
